summary: An air-resistance indoor rower: a 1.74 m aluminium monorail on a steel frame, a spoked fan cage at the front… joints flywheel, damper, seat, strap, handle; options accent; sockets socket_seat, socket_handle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.rowing_machine or place "prefab": "rowing_machine" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
